_about: Curated questId -> chapter map for the per-character Personal Story view. The chapter names (in-game 'My Story' groupings) are not in the API; they are scraped from the GW2 wiki's {{Story infobox}} (whose `id` is the /v2/quests id). `order` is normalized when the wiki marks an Order-specific branch. `arcs` maps the My-Story story ids to a display name. Personal story is frozen, so this is built once + committed. Regenerate with builder/build_personal_story.py.
